ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90% high-intensity (white/light grey) to 10% low-intensity (black/dark) pixels; dark pixels are primarily concentrated at the peduncle base and trailing edge margin.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad, contiguous high-intensity region across both lobes; dark contiguous banding and focal spots localized at the central inferior junction near the peduncle and sparsely near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (1-4 pixel variation) along the continuous trailing edge; visible jagged peaks at the distal-most tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge from the distal tips to the median notch; outer leading edges exhibit convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark pixel clusters located near the central peduncle base; no high-contrast white-on-black rosette formations detected.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, distinct dark spot (possible focal lesion or pigmentation mark) located on the right lobe near the central vertical axis.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white pigmentation across the entire ventral surface, characteristic of a Type 1 fluke classification.
